consolidated_summary: A 2014 Forrester Consulting study (commissioned by SAP) of 302 business and IT decision-makers found that the top reason users avoid enterprise BI applications is the lack of complete data (45%), followed by complexity, incorrect data models, slow results, and restrictive data models. This suggests data availability and quality are critical barriers to adoption.
